| api-backend.retired-def-refusal | 1 | PASS | 5 sampled retired defs + control: human exit 2 / `--json` exit 1, prescriptions where a carrier exists, runtime 400/422 |

## Fail — disposition

**api-backend.enforce-or-remove-authoring-gates A1 — assertion defect.** Copy the showcase; set `showcase_expense_report.rejected_count` `summaryOperations.filter` to `{ status: { $regex: 'rej' } }`; `os build` → exit 0 (twice), `$regex` kept in `dist/objectstack.json`. The clause demands parse/build rejection for the retired-filter-operator registry, but that registry is declared runtime-refused only: `RETIRED_FILTER_OPERATORS` "does not reject anything… the spec declares, the existing refusal sites enforce" (`filter.zod.ts`, `85d95e7d92`, #5701 / #5752 — one day before the clause), and the semantic migration `17.filter-regex-options-retired` records that a stored `{ $regex }` "parses GREEN and always will". Runtime refusal holds: `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task?filter={"title":{"$regex":"a"}}` → 400 `INVALID_FILTER` naming `$icontains`. The seed-time "roll-up summary recompute FAILED … STALE" alongside `success: true` that this fixture produces is declared behaviour too (`seed-loader.ts`, #4998). Verifier V5: CONFIRMED.
